description: This file defines the interface 'SystemConfigurationService' which extends a generic service interface. It declares a method 'getByKey' to retrieve system configuration by key, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationService
classes.description: An interface for system configuration operations, extending core generic entity service and including a method to get configuration by key.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a SystemConfiguration object by its key, may throw ServiceException if retrieval fails.
